body:
One Stop Vape Store is an online retailer of vaping and nicotine products for adults aged 21 and over. It is operated by SV3 LLC, was established in December 2022 and ships from Phoenix, Arizona. This page tells you what we sell, who we serve, how an order moves from checkout to your door, how we handle payments, returns and support, which rules we follow and what we do not do. It is written so that a first-time visitor can decide whether we are the right store for them, and so that a returning customer can find a policy quickly. Nicotine is addictive, our products are for adults only and nothing here is medical advice.

## Who we are
The legal operator is SV3 LLC, doing business as One Stop Vape Store. Our address is 4908 E McDowell Road, Suite 103, Phoenix, Arizona 85008. We began trading in December 2022. We are a retailer, which means we sell products made by other companies, and we are not a medical, legal or regulatory authority. We keep our description of ourselves short and factual, because a store that claims too much is a store to be careful with. See [how to choose a reputable online vape store](/blog/how-to-choose-a-reputable-online-vape-store/) for the checks we think every buyer should run, including on us.

## Our mission
Our stated mission is to give adult vapers a wide choice of quality products, backed by good customer service. We aim to be a dependable place to buy, from a first device to a repeat order, and to explain what we sell in plain language. We say plainly that our products are intended for current smokers, vapers and tobacco users, and that we have no interest in selling to minors.

## What we sell
Our catalog has more than 2,500 products. The largest group is disposable vapes, with more than 1,100 listed. We also sell vape juice and nicotine salts, vape kits, vaporizers, coils and pods, nicotine pouches and Nixodine devices. Many products offer options such as strength or pack size, chosen on the product page, with the price shown for each option. Browse the [catalog](/shop/) or start with [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/), [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/) and [vape kits](/shop/vape-kits/).

## Who we serve
We serve adults aged 21 and over across most of the contiguous United States, and wholesale customers by arrangement. We do not sell to anyone under 21. Every delivery needs an adult to sign, with ID. Some states and cities restrict certain products or flavors, so check the rules where you live. See [what 21+ age verification means](/blog/what-21-plus-age-verification-means/) and [state and local vape laws explained](/blog/state-and-local-vape-laws-explained/).

## How an order works
You choose products and options, add them to your cart and go to checkout. The minimum order is $100. Orders of $200 or more after discount ship free, and smaller orders pay a flat shipping fee. The server calculates prices for every line, so the total you see is the total you pay. You choose a payment method, and we send payment details where needed. We process orders in 24 to 72 business hours, and then a regional carrier delivers. Transit takes about 3 to 7 business days to the West Coast states of Arizona, Nevada, Washington and Idaho, and about 11 to 18 business days to the eastern half of the country. See [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/) and [shipping times from Phoenix](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/).

## Payments
We accept Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, cryptocurrency and gift cards. Cryptocurrency and gift cards save 10 percent. Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime payments are arranged after you place your order, and we send the details to you. Cryptocurrency payments use public wallet addresses, and we never ask for private keys or seed phrases. Gift cards accepted include Apple, Razer, Paysafe, Sephora and Macy's. See [payment methods compared](/blog/payment-methods-compared/) and [how payment details reach you](/blog/how-payment-details-reach-you/).

## Shipping and delivery
Our shipping policy sets out processing times, carriers, transit estimates and the adult signature rule. We ship by regional carriers, and we label parcels as the law requires. If you will not be home, choose an address where an adult can sign. See [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/) and [shipping address tips](/blog/shipping-address-tips/), and read the full [shipping policy](/shipping/).

## Returns and refunds
Returns must be requested within 30 days, and an RMA is required. Opened or used items cannot be returned, and a 15 percent restocking fee applies. Refunds go back through the payment method used for the order. Puffco products are excluded from refunds and exchanges. See [refund and return policy explained](/blog/refund-and-return-policy-explained/) and the full [refund policy](/refunds/).

## Compliance
We follow federal rules for remote sales of vapor products, including the PACT Act, which brought parcel labeling, adult signature and tax and licensing obligations to our category. We also publish an FDA disclaimer, terms of service and a privacy policy. See [the PACT Act explained for vape buyers](/blog/pact-act-explained-for-vape-buyers/), our [FDA disclaimer](/fda-disclaimer/), [terms](/terms/) and [privacy policy](/privacy/).

## What we do not do
We do not make health claims. We do not say any product treats or prevents any condition, and we do not rank our products against other choices on health. We do not invent reviews, ratings or statistics, and if a product has no review, we do not show one. We do not sell to minors. We do not ask for card numbers, passwords or private keys in messages. If you are told otherwise by someone claiming to be us, contact us through the [contact page](/contact/).

## Content and education
We publish guides on buying, payments, shipping, compliance, how devices work and troubleshooting, because informed customers have fewer problems. We write them from our own catalog and policies. If you spot something that looks wrong, tell us.

## Support
You can reach us through the [contact page](/contact/), by email at sales@onestopvapestore.com or by phone on 774-734-1372. When you write, include your order ID, the product name and a short description, and a photo or video if it helps. See [how to contact support](/blog/how-to-contact-support/).

## Wholesale
We offer wholesale ordering for qualified business customers. See [the wholesale ordering guide](/blog/wholesale-ordering-guide/) and the [wholesale page](/wholesale/).

## How we think about trust
A store earns trust by being clear about what it does, and by doing it. That means publishing policies, answering questions, keeping prices honest and not overstating anything. Our policy pages say what we do when something goes wrong, and we would rather you read them before you order than after.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Who runs One Stop Vape Store?
SV3 LLC, doing business as One Stop Vape Store, established in December 2022 and based in Phoenix, Arizona.

### Who can buy?
Adults aged 21 and over, with an adult signature on delivery.

### What is the minimum order?
$100, with free shipping on orders of $200 or more after discount.

### How can I pay?
Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, cryptocurrency and gift cards. Cryptocurrency and gift cards save 10 percent.

### What if something is wrong with my order?
Contact us with your order ID. Our refund policy explains what applies.

## Shop
Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## What a first order looks like
A typical first order includes two or three products chosen to reach the $100 minimum: perhaps a couple of disposables in flavors you enjoy and a pod or a can of pouches if you are curious. You choose the strength or pack size on each product page, add the items to your cart, check each line and go to checkout. You select a payment method, and, for Cash App, Apple Pay or Chime, we send the details after your order. For cryptocurrency, you see a public address and send the amount shown. For gift cards, you follow the steps on the order payment page. Once we confirm payment, the order is processed in 24 to 72 business hours and handed to a regional carrier. You receive tracking when it ships, and an adult signs on arrival. See [how to use the order payment page](/blog/how-to-use-the-order-payment-page/).

## How we handle mistakes
Mistakes happen: a wrong flavor, a damaged box, a delayed parcel. Our approach is to ask you to contact us promptly with your order ID, a clear description and photos, and to explain what applies under our policies. We will not always be able to offer what you hope for, because opened or used items cannot be returned and a restocking fee applies to eligible returns, but we will be clear about the options, and we will answer.

## How to tell us what you think
If a guide is unclear, a page is wrong or a product description does not match what you received, tell us through the [contact page](/contact/). We use that feedback to correct pages and write better guides. We do not publish invented testimonials, so the feedback that matters most to us is the kind that points out what to fix.

## A note on this page
This page describes our business using facts from our own policy and about pages. It does not make claims about rankings, volumes or awards, because we cannot support them with evidence on a page like this. If you need to verify details, our address, phone number and email are on the [contact page](/contact/), and our policies are linked in the footer of every page.
